description: The line plot illustrates the loss ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for different configurations of SepLLM. The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and is on a logarithmic scale ranging from 1e7 to 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and ranges from 94% to 100%. The plot includes five lines representing different configurations: Vanilla (purple line with triangle markers), SepLLM (n=64) (orange line with square markers), SepLLM (n=128) (blue line with cross markers), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green line with diamond markers), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red line with circle markers). The Vanilla line remains constant at 100% loss ratio across all TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64) line starts at approximately 97% loss ratio at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to just below 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=128) line starts at around 96% loss ratio at 1e7 TFLOPs and also increases to just below 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H) line starts at approximately 97% loss ratio at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to just above 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) line starts at around 94% loss ratio at 1e7 TFLOPs and increases to just below 100% at 9e8 TFLOPs.
